name: Isle of the Crows
desc: Isle of the Crows was an island with a number of Authority enemies. When all of them were killed, a boss (simply known as the Authority Captain) would appear and could also be killed. There was a crate that could be retrieved for items, EXP and money. An NPC known as [Commander Rayner](entity:commander_rayner) that could be found in [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit) still mentioned it post-release, but he was removed in a shadow update.
